target: canonical array columns increase LPS +X; rows LPS +Y
operations: lossless transpose/flips only, derived from each source DICOM header
unsupported: reject invalid/missing/non-axial/oblique geometry; no label-based fallback
source_view: lazy index referencing immutable existing arrays; no historical data rewrite
support_interpretation: engineering diagnostic only; exact EchoTime support is not causal identification
